gui.omnicompass.title: Select a Target
omnicompass.configuration.biome_search_r: Maximum distance (in blocks) to search for biomes. Higher values may take cause the search to take longer.
omnicompass.configuration.horizontal_res: The horizontal resolution (in blocks) to use when searching for biomes. Lower values may cause the search to take longer, but may be more accurate.
omnicompass.configuration.structure_sear: Maximum distance (in structure spacing, varies by structure) to search for structures. Higher values may take cause the search to take longer.
omnicompass.configuration.vertical_resol: The vertical resolution (in blocks) to use when searching for biomes. Lower values may cause the search to take longer, but may be more accurate.
